== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes only use this skill on attacking foes. They will use it against single targets and against foes not using an attack skill.

== Notes ==
* If under the effects of a skill which prevents interruption, the target will not be knocked down yet will still receive damage.
* The full description is incorrect. Adjacent foes that are attacking will still be interrupted even if target foe is not attacking, and they will not take damage unless interrupted.
